parts.text: {"units":[{"kind":"requirement","meaning":"Requires an employer to clearly demonstrate that full-time teachers at educational institutions did not work 1,250 hours during the prior 12 months to deny them FMLA eligibility on hours grounds, noting teachers often work outside classrooms or at home, and cross-referencing § 825.801(d) for airline flight crew rules.","quote_ref":"F014:F999","scope_refs":[]}]}
